caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork quilt composed of square blocks arranged on point, each featuring a distinct geometric or floral pattern. The color palette includes various shades of red, blue, yellow, green, brown, purple, pink, and beige. Each block contains a unique design, including crosses, stars, flowers, sunbursts, hearts, and intricate polygonal patterns, created with differently colored sections. The overall composition consists of rows of these blocks, with their corners oriented upward, giving the impression of diamonds. The blocks are separated and bordered by a lattice made of a beige, blue, and brown tessellated cube pattern. The background of the drawing is a plain beige color, and the entire quilt is centered on the page. A signature is visible at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Bedspread (Detail of Center)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
